notes.title: Update v1.2.1: Ravenwood Raid
notes.notes:
🎉 The new 6-man raid 'RAVENWOOD' is now available! 🎉

Here are the patch notes of today's release:

[list]
[*] Raids were previously only accessible on Hell difficulty, but this has been changed:
[list]
[*] 'Bosquet' raid invites will now be sent to players that have completed the first quest of Normal difficulty.
[*] 'Prairie' raid invites will now be sent to players that have completed the first quest of Nightmare difficulty.
[*] 'Ravenwood' raid invites will now be sent to players that have completed the first quest of Hell difficulty.
[/list]
[*] The Bosquet raid now has an area level of 10.
[*] The Prairie raid now has an area level of 28.
[*] The Ravenwood raid now has an area level of 46.
[*] Added a new Steam achievement 'Demon Slayer' for slaying the demonic trinity in the Ravenwood raid.
[*] Minipets Ghost Cat (T3) and Radioactive Cat (T3) drops are now enabled on the Ravenwood raid bosses.
[*] Added the ability to join a raid from a different difficulty (only if already unlocked).
[*] Raid rewards are now found in a chest after killing a raid boss.
[*] Increased the drop ratio for weapons/money to 30/70 (from 20/80).
[*] Money bills now have a minimum amount of $10.
[*] Fixed a bug where players could teleport out of the arena on the Bosquet raid.
[*] Fixed a bug where the Samurai Boss may resuscitate instantly after his death.
[*] Fixed a bug where the health bar of monsters may not disappear upon death.
[/list]

Thank you for your interest in [b]The Unnamed Game[/b]!

notes.title: 2025/04/21 Update Patch v1.1.3
notes.notes:
An update has been released.

Changes are as follow:

[b]Minipets have been added to the game![/b]
[list]
[*] Minipets can be dropped from Raid bosses and their rarity (skin variation) is divided in three tiers.
[*] The boss from the Prairie raid now has a 20% chance to drop: Brown Cat (T1), Grey Cat (T1).
[*] The boss from the Bosquet raid now has a 10% chance to drop: Orange Cat (T2), Black Cat (T2).
[*] The boss from the (upcoming) raid will have a 3% chance to drop: Ghost Cat (T3), Radioactive Cat (T3).
[*] The drop chance for unique weapons on raid bosses has been increased from 3% to 5%.
[*] A new shortcut has been added on the HUD to set your active minipet.
[/list]

Thank you for your continued support!

notes.title: Upcoming release
notes.notes:
I am thrilled to announce the official release of The Unnamed Game on [b]March 19th, 2025[/b]!

It has been seven years since I started this project in February 2018, dedicating countless hours building this multiplayer game from scratch. The first alpha version made its debut on May 11, 2020 and since then, I have rolled out [url=https://theunnamedgame.com/Patch_Notes]115 patches[/url].

What began as a side-project has evolved into a game with solid fundations and hours of content. However, there's still room for improvements, and plenty of content to add, particularly in areas like character customization, questing, and map diversity.

Thanks to the ongoing Playtest, most players have experienced the game in full, so there will be no account or character resets. However, I will reset the seasonal ladders in both the Softcore and Hardcore realms.

Looking ahead, The Unnamed Game will continue to grow, with periodic updates including content patches and bug fixes. Instead of prolonging the Playtest or launching in Early Access, I've decided it's time to release the game outright.

I eagerly await this date and look forward to seeing you in-game, soldiers!

[i]P.S.: It is still time to join the [url=https://discord.gg/56ru8umN7X]official Discord server[/url] before the release to get the "Beta Tester" role![/i]

notes.title: Major update v0.16: Softcore & Hardcore servers
notes.notes:
🚀 The Beta version v0.16 of The Unnamed Game is now available!

It is now possible to join new "Softcore" servers in all regions. Existing characters have been transferred to "Hardcore" servers.

In "Softcore" mode, the death of your characters is not permanent. However, the experience bar progress for the current level is reset.

See you soon!
